items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: I mean I knew these guys you know, so when they saw me they said who’s with you?

ctx.x: Can you look at your career and pick out some really fond memories right now? Recording sessions or just particular nights where the group of musicians you were playing with was very just really outstanding? Is that possible with all the playing you’ve done over the years? Can you think back and say boy, I’m so glad that one happened?

Well I’ve had some outstanding nights, memorable nights, as a soloist and in some trio settings too. As a soloist my most memorable nights would be my first time in Europe ever. And I was called to play the Montreux Jazz Festival in Switzerland, that was my first time ever in Europe and I was doing a solo. I think that, I’m trying to remember who was on that night, I think they had maybe three or four different artists on that night, I think Stan Getz, Stan Getz’s group was playing, and I think Chuck Mangione’s…
You could just feel that kind of electricity?
